issue.body:
## Problem

When `sample-kit.json` is absent, `loadConfig` throws `config missing`. The message names neither the file nor the fix.

## Fix

Change the message to exactly:

`sample-kit.json not found in <dir>; run sample-kit init to create it.`

where `<dir>` is the directory that was searched.

## Done when

- [ ] The message reads as above.
- [ ] The test for the missing file expects the new message.

Out of scope: any other change to `loadConfig`.

pr.title: fix(sample-kit): name the file and the fix in the missing-config error
pr.body: Rewords the missing-config error as the issue specifies and updates its test.
